newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to establish rural cooperative bank.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to establish rural cooperative bank.

text.p: Shanghai will establish an agricultural cooperative bank by merging 227 credit unions in the city's suburbs, the Business News said on Tuesday.
The bank was expected to be set up before the end of the year and would be a share-holding commercial bank, the paper said.
By the end of July, the 227 rural credit unions had combined deposits of 20.7 billion yuan and total outstanding loans worth 14.7 billion yuan, the paper said.
Last year, Shanghai established an urban cooperative bank by combining 99 credit offices in the city proper.

The setting up of such co-operative banks by merging credit unions in rural and urban areas in China is part of Beijing's efforts to consolidate its sprawling banking industry and set up commercially viable entities.
